changes.title: Tree cap sliders
items: Pause-page sliders for the tallest trees' height (Tree height cap): how much of a tree over the cap it keeps, and where the cap starts

changes.title: Area blend
items: Neighbouring areas blend more gradually: their trees and bushes mix across a wider, wandering band

changes.title: No tilt house
items: No more tilt-shift blur in the treehouse: the rooms, branches and Terrace stay sharp, the blur easing back as you fly off
